base: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a realistic, agency-quality FULL DESKTOP HOMEPAGE design for E4ENGINEERS. One single tall image, target 1440 x 3600 px, crisp high-resolution type, entire header through footer visible, no cropping, no browser frame, no external presentation board. This is a visual approval prototype, not code. Attached existing-site screenshot is ONLY brand/content background; DO NOT COPY its layout or colors. Retain textual E4ENGINEERS wordmark. Audience: engineering/diploma students, engineers, faculty, technical professionals. Platform balances engineering knowledge, articles, courses, study resources, journals/publications and physical books. Light surfaces dominate, highly readable 16px body-equivalent type, purposeful whitespace, sophisticated technical illustrations, no people, no neon, no gradients, no fake statistics or testimonials. Separate major sections with space and fine rules rather than endless cards. Header: restrained navigation Engineering / Learn / Publications / Books / About, search, account and cart. Every design MUST include eight engineering disciplines (Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Mining, Electronics, Computer Science, Power Systems, Engineering Mathematics), articles, courses, study resources, physical books, journals/publications, value statement, updates, substantial multi-column footer. Book section includes covers, title, 'Sample author', example price ₹499, original ₹599, 'Save ₹100', Add to cart and View book. Clearly label the book/catalogue area 'Illustrative catalogue · sample titles and prices'. Other sample resources labelled 'Sample content'. No ratings. Actual source article titles usable: 'Power System Economics', 'Architecture of Smart Grid', 'Choice of Generator Units'. Actual course: 'Fundamentals of Electrical and Electronics Engineering'. Digital resources show Free / Premium. Current date 24 September 2026; avoid dates unless necessary. Include thoughtful technical diagrams and book cover design. No illegible lorem ipsum or tiny filler. Full footer includes Engineering, Learning, Publications, Shop, Company and Privacy/Terms/Contact links. All content must fit naturally without warped dimensions.
directions: Modern Engineering Knowledge Portal. Clean authoritative academic portal in white, deep navy #16324F, engineering blue #2463B5 and pale steel. Modern humanist sans type. Content-driven hero with 'Engineering knowledge, connected.' and short support 'Explore articles, courses, study resources, publications and books.' Wide prominent universal search beneath title, two CTAs Explore engineering / Browse resources. Thin precise technical network visual on right. Subject navigator directly below hero as an elegant 4x2 grid with understated line icons. Then featured knowledge: one lead illustrated article and two compact text teasers. Next horizontal courses band. Resource download rows. Books 3-up with upright covers. Publications as a horizontal issue strip. Why E4ENGINEERS text columns, compact latest updates then full footer. Generous white space, calm structured rhythm.

Premium Engineering Education Platform. Sophisticated light ivory #FAF8F3, navy #172C42, muted gold #B39155. Refined modern sans. Dramatic asymmetric split hero: left 'Build deeper engineering understanding.' with concise ecosystem support text and Explore courses / Explore knowledge CTAs; right elegant large exploded mechanical assembly drawing with precise technical annotations on pale ivory. Narrow universal search in header. Immediately below: three learning-path panels Foundation / Applied engineering / Professional reference, with discipline names. Then two expansive course features including the electrical fundamentals course. Follow with eight-discipline typographic navigator as two clean columns. Articles in an image-led horizontal triptych. Resource area as a wide gold-tinted feature plus free/premium list. Physical books presented on a refined shelf with 3 covers and ecommerce controls. Journals shown as two issue spreads. Value statement and workshop update, substantial footer. Luxury academic catalogue rhythm with generous spacing, modest gold accents, no excessive rounding.

Engineering Digital Library. Search-first library on white #FFFFFF, pale sage #F0F5F2, ink #213B36, restrained teal #34796B. Modern highly legible sans plus small monospaced metadata. Hero 'Find your next engineering insight.' with huge universal search bar and short examples, Browse library / Explore subjects actions. Discovery tabs All / Articles / Notes / Courses / Books / Journals beneath search. Below hero use distinctive LIBRARY CATALOGUE layout: narrow left subject index listing eight disciplines; broad right content area with curated articles in horizontal indexed rows with thumbnail and resource-type tags, never dashboard widgets. Continue full-width collections for study materials with Free/Premium tags, two course learning resources, then publications with large upright issue covers and descriptive catalogue records. Physical books displayed as a library shelf and concise purchase metadata, 3 items. Why this library: three concise text statements; recent additions as a dated-free list. Large quiet footer. This remains a homepage with a complete hero and footer, not a search results screen. Crisp orderly high content density yet generous row spacing.

Engineering Marketplace + Knowledge. Balanced marketplace in white #FFFFFF, midnight blue #16304B, warm orange #CA6437, pale blue panels. Friendly professional sans, clean practical ecommerce details. Header in two functional tiers: logo + broad universal search + account/cart above compact category nav. Hero 'Knowledge to learn. Resources to build.' in asymmetrical 60/40 composition: large knowledge feature with circuit/infrastructure illustration and Explore knowledge CTA; smaller adjacent books feature with real-looking book stack and Shop books CTA. Four quick discovery lanes Articles / Courses / Study materials / Publications. Featured engineering books comes next, 4 clean product columns, clear sample catalogue label, covers and all purchase metadata; no ratings or urgency claims. Eight engineering disciplines as a horizontal two-row icon navigator. Articles as two wide illustrated features. Courses and free/premium resources in paired but spacious sections. Academic journals as a broad publication feature. Why E4ENGINEERS value strip, new resources update and comprehensive footer. More retail visibility while retaining equal knowledge discovery, no Amazon clutter or nested cards.

Editorial Engineering Authority. Most distinctive premium technical publisher. Warm white #F7F5EF, charcoal navy #202C36, restrained rust #A65436. Confident editorial serif headings paired with clean sans text. Masthead E4ENGINEERS across top left with quiet search/account/cart, slender navigation below. Hero as editorial opening spread with huge serif headline 'Ideas that power engineering.' left; fine black technical turbine/circuit illustration on right, restrained ecosystem deck and Read articles / Explore resources links. Beneath it a curated lead story 'Architecture of Smart Grid' paired with two smaller typographic stories separated by rules, not cards. Eight disciplines presented as a beautiful numbered two-column index. Publications/journals as a large issue-cover feature with editorial abstract. Courses as two concise syllabus-like rows. Resources laid out as a technical reading list with Free and Premium tags. Selected physical books as an asymmetrical book review spread with 3 covers and ecommerce metadata (sample author/prices labels), Add to cart and View book links. Value manifesto 'For the discipline of engineering.' followed by compact updates and substantial publisher-style footer. Strong varied column widths, no repeating card grids, no newspaper clutter.
